playlist_description:
Sevenfold — The Broken Atlas is an original illustrated progression-fantasy audiobook from Mythveil Audiobooks.

Follow Shen Yu, a young survey apprentice who discovers that a familiar crossing no longer points where it should. His investigation draws him into a dangerous mystery—and the extraordinary power of Sevenfold.

Episodes appear here in their correct listening order, beginning with Volume I. Listen from Episode 01 to follow the mysteries, characters and carefully defined progression system.

Narration: Kokoro Michael. Original background music and illustrated fantasy visuals.

Produced by Mythveil Audiobooks.
